Welcome to Agent School — lesson twelve.
You now know three ways to make AI fit your job.
Free, instant — always try this first.
Give it your knowledge — documents, policies, products.
Retrain the model on your examples.
It changes how it behaves — its style, its format — not so much what it knows.
Most people jump straight to fine-tuning… to teach the AI facts.
That's the expensive way to do RAG.
So the order is: prompt first.
Add RAG when it needs knowledge.
Fine-tune only when it needs a new behavior you can't prompt.
Remember: prompt, then RAG, then fine-tune.
